Frequently asked questions

Important details before you begin.

Can reports be separated by property?

Yes. The chart of accounts, classes, locations or entity structure can be designed around the reporting needs and accounting platform.

Do you replace a property-management platform?

No. ClarityGrid can help reconcile and connect property-management data with the accounting system.
